description: This file defines utility functions and classes related to security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes functions for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and managing plugin states and activation.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and writing curl responses.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job that executes a provided function, with different inheritance depending on the compilation flag.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, either from cache or by invoking security utilities, with thread safety.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Appends data received from curl to a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security is configured by querying a local service and parsing the JSON response.
